manual_review.center_and_ties: For s in[1/2,2], floor(1/2-log2(s)) equals1 for s^2<=1/2,0 for1/2<s^2<=2,and-1 for s^2>2. Integer translation removes ell exactly; rational boxes that straddle either irrational threshold remain OPEN. No tie rounding is introduced.
manual_review.support: For positive s,r, abs(log2(r*s))<3/4 is exactly1/8<(r*s)^4<8. The fourth power is monotone on positive values. Closed boxes wholly outside the strict support return zero; crossing boxes remain OPEN. This does not classify the independent radial guard.
manual_review.covariance: For positive r,s, F(r*s;r^(1/2-h)Z,rT)=rF(s;Z,T), eta is unchanged,and Rprime^2/(2*sprime)=R^2/(2*s). Active band support puts transported root strictly inside original(1/2,2). The statements concern correlated transports of original input points, not every Cartesian combination of returned marginal intervals.
manual_review.axial_enclosure: Integer center offset and candidate displacement force |delta|<=2. With bits>=16,epsilon=|delta|*2^(-bits-32)<=2^-47<1. For x=h*|delta|*log(2) in[0,epsilon], exp(-x) lies in[1-epsilon,1] and exp(x) lies in[1,1/(1-epsilon)]. Positive sqrt(r) outward enclosures preserve the product bounds. Actual h stays strictly positive.
manual_review.scope: Actual external global R/Z/T provenance, integer ell>=ell0/coefficient window, fixed mesh ceilings/representative inputs, radial integrals and nonzero whole-K fields remain unverified. No N7-06/N8-05 closure, no new M3 closure,and tau remains null. Frozen-label derivative multipliers hold both integer labels fixed; no derivative of the nearest-label map is claimed.
